title: OpenNodes usage receipt
description: The payload of an ONP usage receipt (ONP-5 §5). The receipt travels as a compact JWS (RFC 7515) whose payload is the JCS (RFC 8785) serialization of this object, signed by a key the node's origin publishes, under the algorithm rule of ONP-2 §8. The prose in ONP-5 is normative for semantics; unknown members follow the must-ignore rules of ONP-1 §5.

receipt_id.description: Unique per node. A receipt published by URL is found under this id.

card_revision.description: The card revision whose pricing the amount uses: the one the client pinned (ONP-4 §2).

request_hash.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw request body bytes as received.

completion_tokens.description: Includes reasoning tokens, at the output price (ONP-5 §1).

scheme.description: The payment scheme used, e.g. free, prepaid, x402.

payment_ref.description: Scheme-specific reference, e.g. an x402 payment.
